title: Yellow Mech Boy Quad
description: Four nearly identical full-body views of a young boy wearing heavy black and yellow mechanical armor with skull and drip motifs, standing in a combat pose against a dark background. The leftmost figure has no goggles while the three figures to the right wear tinted goggles.
prompt: A young boy with spiky blonde hair and face tattoos wearing bulky black and bright yellow mechanical armor with skull chest emblem and dripping details, heavy boots and knee pads, standing in a powerful wide stance, multiple angled views side by side, dramatic studio lighting, dark background, highly detailed digital painting, character design study
